subject: Re: Sample corridor — MAP & delivery cadence for eval assets
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <e.chen@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sample corridor — MAP & delivery cadence for eval assets

Hi Emily,

Great talking earlier — per our discussion I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out a tight delivery cadence for the evaluation assets (prompt pack + curated testcases + a small sample dataset) and the close timeline we discussed. High-level proposal:

- Week 0 (this week): Redwood shares promptpack sample and testcase index (ephemeral access)
- Week 1: Acme runs smoke tests in sandbox; Redwood provides two support sessions
- Week 2: Final dataset transfer, legal sign-off on usage constraints, and go/no-go
- Target close: 2027-04-12 (sufficient runway for procurement + legal)

Usage constraints we’d like to keep explicit in the MAP: evaluation only (no model resale), deletion of sample within 30 days of takedown, and a limited token consumption telemetry report for joint QA. I attached MAP-draft-20270321.xlsx and a small promptpack stub so your engineers can peek.

Can you confirm Acme’s preferred legal review owner and whether we should route redlines through procurement or your legal alias? If the timeline works, I’ll loop in Marissa for the onboarding checklist and Ben for pricing approval.

Thanks — I’ll be online tomorrow morning for a quick sync if you want to run the cadence together.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0213

Attachments: MAP-draft-20270321.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24KB), promptpack-sample.tar.gz (archive, 2.1MB)

From: Emily Chen <e.chen@acme-retail.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@acme-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sample corridor — MAP & delivery cadence for eval assets

Sofia,

Thanks — the cadence looks reasonable. A few quick clarification items from our side:

1) Retention: when you say "deletion of sample within 30 days" — can you confirm who performs deletion (Acme or Redwood) and whether we get a delete confirmation report?
2) Usage constraints: our legal will want explicit language about model-training prohibition and any derivative dataset creation.
3) Sandbox tokens: can you provide an ephemeral sandbox token scoped to the sample so our infra folks can run the smoke tests without broad access?

Routing: please route contract redlines to legal@acme-retail.com; procurement will then issue the PO once redlines are accepted.

Looping in our Legal. Emily

On Mon, Mar 22, 2027 at 09:03 AM Legal Team <legal@acme-retail.com> wrote:
> Thanks — we’ll aim to turn on redlines within 3 business days and will call out any non-starters.
> 
> — Acme Legal

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <e.chen@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sample corridor — MAP & delivery cadence for eval assets

Hi Emily — appreciate the quick notes. Responses inline here: 

1) Deletion: Redwood will perform the deletion from our ephemeral sandbox endpoints and provide a deletion report (sha256 manifest) to Acme within 48 hours of takedown. We’ll add that to the MAP and include the confirmation step under the "Close" milestone.

2) Usage constraints: agreed — we’ll add explicit prohibition language for model training, dataset resale, and derivative distribution. We’ll also include an audit window where Redwood can provide token-level telemetry (count only, no payload) for joint QA.

3) Sandbox token: attached is an ephemeral token stub with scope info and an access expiry of 10 days. If you want a longer burner window for the smoke test, say 14 days, we can extend.

I attached promptpack-sample.tar.gz (contains a 150-message prompt subset) and testcases-list.csv. For clarity I also added a one-page MAP milestone slate in the spreadsheet (same file updated). Target close remains 2027-04-12 — if procurement needs more runway we can flex but this target syncs with our availability.

Next steps I propose:
- Acme legal returns redlines (legal@acme-retail.com) by Fri 3/26
- Redwood responds to redlines and issues DocuSign link by Mon 3/29
- Technical handoff call: Tue 3/30 (30 minutes) to validate sandbox and testcases

Ben/Marissa — tagging you both for pricing and onboarding resource alignment.

Best,
Sofia

Attachments: promptpack-sample.tar.gz (archive, 2.1MB), testcases-list.csv (csv, 18KB), MAP-draft-20270321.xlsx (updated)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sample corridor — MAP & delivery cadence for eval assets

Ack — I reviewed the milestone slate and availability. Pricing for the sample corridor will be the standard pilot credit (waived up to $2k); if Acme requests any extended dedicated hours or deeper custom support we’ll need to book a paid enablement block. I’m fine moving to DocuSign on Monday once legal has redlines.

—Ben
Director, Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Legal Team <legal@acme-retail.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Chen <e.chen@acme-retail.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sample corridor — MAP & delivery cadence for eval assets

Sofia — attached is a short redline summary (acme-redlines-summary.pdf). No material blockers but two asks:

- Add explicit takedown timeline (we want confirmation that samples will be deleted from Redwood-managed sandboxes within 30 calendar days and that Acme can request early takedown)
- Add an export-control clause referencing EU restrictions (Acme operates in EU as well)

If you can accept the two edits, we’ll ask procurement to route the PO immediately upon DocuSign.

Regards,
Acme Legal

Attachments: acme-redlines-summary.pdf (pdf, 6KB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <e.chen@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sample corridor — MAP & delivery cadence for eval assets

Emily / Acme Legal — thanks for the quick turnaround and clear asks. We can accept both redlines:

- Takedown confirmation: Redwood will perform deletion within 30 calendar days or sooner on request; deletion report (sha256) provided within 48 hours of takedown.
- Export control language: we’ll add the EU export-control paragraph and route the revised MAP to DocuSign.

I’ll upload the revised MAP to the drive link (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2bMAP-draft) and generate the DocuSign envelope today. Expect DocuSign link in your inbox by 15:00 PT. Once signed we’ll:

1) Push sandbox token to your infra team (14-day ephemeral)
2) Kick off the technical 30-minute handoff on Tue 3/30 (calendar invite pending)
3) Send the onboarding playbook to Marissa for the test-run checklist

If procurement needs anything else for PO issuance (SOW, billing contact), tell me and I’ll route it immediately.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai

Related links: DocuSign (https://app.docusign.com/ACME-MAP-1198), Drive MAP (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2bMAP-draft)
